*Kusalattika, Upādānadukādi* is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka. Within the structural scheme of the Paṭṭhāna, this text examines conditional relations combining the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*) with the dyads beginning with clinging (*upādānadukādi*).

No curated cross-language parallels or external matches with Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora are recorded for this section [DharmaNexus].
